questionAudits.original: We arranged for a specialist to repair the furnace controller last week.
questionAudits.target: We ____ by a specialist last week.
completedSentences: We got the furnace controller repaired by a specialist last week.
questionAudits.rationale: get something done表示安排他人完成，got保留上周过去事件，by a specialist仍明确专家施事；repair应为被动分词repaired。

questionAudits.original: The beginner was not accustomed to working near such heat.
questionAudits.target: The beginner was ____ near such heat.
completedSentences: The beginner was not used to working near such heat.
questionAudits.rationale: be used to doing表示习惯于某种环境中的工作，not保留尚不习惯；to在此为介词，后接working而非work。

questionAudits.original: The designer gave us permission to photograph the glassmaking process.
completedSentences: The designer allowed us to photograph the glassmaking process.
questionAudits.rationale: allow somebody to do对应给予拍摄许可，保留设计师、我们和过去许可事件；不定式to不能在这个补语结构中省略。

questionAudits.original: They polished the panel for an hour before the crack became visible.
questionAudits.target: They ____ the panel before the crack became visible.
completedSentences: They spent an hour polishing the panel before the crack became visible.
They had spent an hour polishing the panel before the crack became visible.
questionAudits.rationale: spend time doing表达花一小时抛光，before保留裂纹出现前的时间顺序；简单过去或过去完成均可，to polish不能替换动名词补语。

questionAudits.original: Visitors are forbidden to enter the cooling area.
accepted: no account are visitors to enter
completedSentences: On no account may visitors enter the cooling area.
On no account are visitors to enter the cooling area.
On no account must visitors enter the cooling area.
questionAudits.rationale: on no account前置表示绝对禁止并要求助动词与主语部分倒装；保留游客不得进入，不能写成未倒装的visitors may。

questionAudits.original: I forgot to wear gloves, and I regret it now.
completedSentences: I wish I had worn gloves.
I wish I'd worn gloves.
questionAudits.rationale: wish加过去完成时表示对先前没有戴手套的遗憾，保留现在后悔与过去未做的关系；have worn不能在此表达过去反事实。

questionAudits.original: The cable-car service stopped because of ice.
questionAudits.target: The stoppage of the cable-car service ____ ice.
completedSentences: The stoppage of the cable-car service was due to ice.
questionAudits.rationale: be due to在此说明停运由冰造成，名词化仍保留相同过去事件与原因；due of不构成这种原因搭配。

questionAudits.original: The guide advised us not to lean out of the car.
completedSentences: The guide advised us against leaning out of the car.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: advised us against to lean out
questionAudits.rationale: advise somebody against doing表示劝我们不要探身，保留导游给建议而非禁止的言语行为；against后不能接to lean。

questionAudits.original: We could not see the valley because of the thick cloud.
completedSentences: The thick cloud prevented us from seeing the valley.
The thick cloud prevented us seeing the valley.
questionAudits.rationale: prevent somebody from doing或英式省略from均能表达浓云阻碍我们看谷地；to seeing不是该动词合格的补语形式。

questionAudits.original: The last car left before the storm arrived.
questionAudits.target: When the storm arrived, the last car ____.
completedSentences: When the storm arrived, the last car had already left.
questionAudits.rationale: 过去完成时had already left保留最后一车先离开、暴风后到的顺序；has already leave既错置现在时又缺过去分词。

questionAudits.original: Operators will refund your ticket if the service remains closed.
accepted: provided that the service remains closed
completedSentences: Operators will refund your ticket provided the service remains closed.
Operators will refund your ticket provided that the service remains closed.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: provided that service the remains closed
questionAudits.rationale: provided或provided that在此引出持续关闭这一退款条件，保留will主句；限定词the不能置于service之后，service the破坏从句的名词短语结构。

questionAudits.original: The engineer checked the cable every day while she worked there.
questionAudits.target: The engineer ____ every day while she worked there.
completedSentences: The engineer used to check the cable every day while she worked there.
questionAudits.rationale: used to加动词原形表达她在当地任职时的过去习惯，保留每日检查；它不同于be used to doing，不能写checking。

questionAudits.original: The rules do not allow you to take this move back.
questionAudits.target: Under the rules, you ____ this move back.
completedSentences: Under the rules, you are not allowed to take this move back.
Under the rules, you aren't allowed to take this move back.
questionAudits.rationale: be not allowed to do转换为受规则约束的被动许可，保持不能悔棋；allowed后需要to take而不是taking。

questionAudits.original: I only realised my king was in trouble after the clock had stopped.
questionAudits.target: I did not realise my king was in trouble ____.
completedSentences: I did not realise my king was in trouble until the clock had stopped.
questionAudits.rationale: not realise until对应计时停止后才意识到，保留过去完成的先后；has stop混用现在助动词和非分词，不能构成该过去关系。

questionAudits.original: I am sure you moved the knight before starting the clock.
completedSentences: You must have moved the knight before starting the clock.
questionAudits.rationale: must have done表达现在对过去走马行为的确定推断，保留you施事及启钟前；情态动词后用have而不是had。

questionAudits.original: The arbiter cancelled the game because of a connection failure.
questionAudits.target: The game ____ because of a connection failure.
completedSentences: The game was cancelled by the arbiter because of a connection failure.
questionAudits.rationale: 被动was cancelled把棋局作主语，by仍保留裁判施事，连接故障原因不变；from不能在此替代被动施事介词。

questionAudits.original: It is not worth arguing about that position.
completedSentences: There is no point in arguing about that position.
questionAudits.rationale: there is no point in doing表示争论该局面没有意义，对应not worth；in后用动名词，to arguing不符合此固定结构。

questionAudits.original: The only thing I want to do now is review the endgame.
completedSentences: all I want to do now is review the endgame.
questionAudits.rationale: all I want to do构成主语，保留现在只想复盘残局而非另一行动；want后的to接原形do，不能写doing。

questionAudits.original: The pilot transfer was cancelled because of heavy fog.
questionAudits.target: The pilot transfer was cancelled ____ heavy fog.
completedSentences: The pilot transfer was cancelled as a result of heavy fog.
questionAudits.rationale: as a result of引出浓雾这一取消原因，事件和过去被动都保持不变；固定搭配结尾为of而非to。

questionAudits.original: The captain does not intend to sail without a pilot.
completedSentences: The captain has no intention of sailing without a pilot.
The captain hasn't any intention of sailing without a pilot.
questionAudits.rationale: have no intention of doing表示船长没有无引航员出航的打算，保留否定意向；to sailing不能替代of加动名词。

questionAudits.original: No unauthorised person is allowed to board the launch.
accepted: do not have permission to board
completedSentences: Unauthorised people do not have permission to board the launch.
Unauthorised people have no permission to board the launch.
Unauthorised people don't have permission to board the launch.
questionAudits.rationale: have no permission to board表达未经授权者没有登艇许可，保留规则性否定；permission后的动作需to board而非boarding。

questionAudits.original: It was necessary for the crew to secure the rope before departing.
completedSentences: The crew had to secure the rope before departing.
questionAudits.rationale: had to do表达过去必须固定绳索，before departing仍保留离开之前的要求；to后应为secure而非securing。

questionAudits.original: The pilot agreed to board only after he saw the ladder's inspection record.
questionAudits.target: ____ the ladder's inspection record did the pilot agree to board.
completedSentences: only after he saw the ladder's inspection record did the pilot agree to board.
only after he had seen the ladder's inspection record did the pilot agree to board.
questionAudits.rationale: only after前置接时间从句，主句已有did倒装，saw或had seen均保留查看记录后才同意登船；过去事件不能用he see。

questionAudits.original: The duty officer made certain that all names were recorded.
accepted: made sure that all names were
completedSentences: The duty officer made sure all names were recorded.
The duty officer made sure that all names were recorded.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: made sure that all names was
questionAudits.rationale: make sure与make certain对应，保留值班员确保所有名字被记下；复数all names的过去被动助动词为were，不是was。

questionAudits.original: Their footage was so blurred that we could not identify the fish.
accepted: was too blurred for us to
completedSentences: Their footage was too blurred for us to identify the fish.
questionAudits.rationale: too blurred for us to do保留影像模糊到我们无法辨鱼的结果；for us后需to连接identify，不能直接接动词。

questionAudits.original: She finds it difficult to edit audio and video at the same time.
questionAudits.target: She ____ audio and video at the same time.
completedSentences: She has difficulty editing audio and video at the same time.
She has difficulty in editing audio and video at the same time.
questionAudits.rationale: have difficulty doing或in doing表示同时剪音画有困难，保持她的当下情况；to editing不属于此补语结构。

questionAudits.original: The narrator must pronounce every place name correctly.
questionAudits.target: It ____ pronounce every place name correctly.
accepted: is essential for the narrator to
completedSentences: It is essential for the narrator to pronounce every place name correctly.
It is essential that the narrator pronounce every place name correctly.
questionAudits.rationale: It is essential for somebody to do或that加原形虚拟语气均保留叙述者必须正确读地名；for结构缺to时不能直接接pronounce。

questionAudits.original: We will release the film if all permissions arrive.
completedSentences: We will release the film provided all permissions arrive.
We will release the film provided that all permissions arrive.
questionAudits.rationale: provided引出所有许可到齐这一发布条件，不改变主句will或肯定条件关系；复数permissions后的动词应为arrive。

questionAudits.original: I regret including that unverified caption.
completedSentences: I wish I had not included that unverified caption.
I wish I hadn't included that unverified caption.
questionAudits.rationale: wish加过去完成否定表示后悔已经加了未核实字幕，保留过去行为与现在遗憾；would not included既缺正确动词结构也不表达该反事实。

questionAudits.original: The editor made us remove the title card.
questionAudits.target: We ____ the title card by the editor.
completedSentences: We were made to remove the title card by the editor.
questionAudits.rationale: make somebody do转被动为somebody were made to do，必须恢复to；by the editor保留编辑施事，事件仍为过去强制删除片头卡。

questionAudits.original: The contractor completed the repair even though the pump failed.
completedSentences: The contractor completed the repair despite the pump failing.
The contractor completed the repair despite the pump's failure.
The contractor completed the repair despite the pump failure.
questionAudits.rationale: despite后接名词或动名词结构，均保留泵故障但修复仍完成的让步；不能直接跟the pump had failed有限从句。

questionAudits.original: The council rejected our proposal for a more powerful pump.
questionAudits.target: The council ____ for a more powerful pump.
completedSentences: The council turned down our proposal for a more powerful pump.
questionAudits.rationale: turn down表示拒绝方案，保留委员会施事、我们的提案及过去时间；该短语直接接宾语，不在our proposal前加to。

questionAudits.original: The fountain's most recent use was twenty years before the restoration began.
accepted: after the fountain was last used
completedSentences: The restoration began twenty years after the fountain was last used.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: after the fountain last was use
questionAudits.rationale: after the fountain was last used保留最近使用在修复前二十年的先后，被动需used过去分词；was use不成被动结构。

questionAudits.original: The council considers durability more important than colour.
accepted: gives higher priority to durability than
completedSentences: The council gives durability priority over colour.
The council gives higher priority to durability than colour.
questionAudits.rationale: give something priority over another或give higher priority to...than均保留耐久优先于颜色的方向；无higher时priority than缺少正确比较结构。

questionAudits.original: Without local donations, the work would have stopped.
completedSentences: The work would have stopped but for local donations.
questionAudits.rationale: but for表示若没有，保留当地捐款避免工程停下的过去反事实；but from不是这一条件表达。

questionAudits.original: The engineer warned us not to switch on the pump.
completedSentences: The engineer warned us against switching on the pump.
questionAudits.rationale: warn somebody against doing保留工程师警告我们不要开泵，属于警示而非新增命令；against后用switching不能用to switch。

questionAudits.original: The ceramicist would prefer us to keep the door closed.
completedSentences: The ceramicist would rather we kept the door closed.
questionAudits.rationale: would rather somebody did表示希望别人当下保持门关，过去式为偏好虚拟而非过去事件；we keeping缺少有限谓语。

questionAudits.original: The clay was not soft enough to shape by hand.
completedSentences: The clay was too hard to shape by hand.
questionAudits.rationale: not soft enough对应too hard，保持泥太硬不能手塑；too hard后接to shape，不用for shape。

questionAudits.original: The kiln manager did not give us permission to add another piece.
questionAudits.target: We ____ another piece by the kiln manager.
accepted: were not given permission to add
completedSentences: We were not given permission to add another piece by the kiln manager.
We weren't given permission to add another piece by the kiln manager.
questionAudits.rationale: 被动were not given permission to add保留经理未给我们加件许可，by仍指定同一施事；permission的动作补语不能直接用adding。

questionAudits.original: She took great care while sanding the edge.
completedSentences: She was very careful when sanding the edge.
She was very careful while sanding the edge.
questionAudits.rationale: take great care对应was very careful，when或while sanding保留打磨时的谨慎；省略从句中when sand不能构成合法动词结构。

questionAudits.original: The curators agreed to keep both earlier prototypes.
accepted: came to an agreement to keep
completedSentences: The curators came to an agreement to keep both earlier prototypes.
The curators reached an agreement to keep both earlier prototypes.
questionAudits.rationale: come to或reach an agreement to do保留策展人达成保留两个旧样的共识；come to an agreement这一搭配必须在came之后保留to，不能直接接an agreement。

questionAudits.original: I expected that I would find it difficult to complete the residency application.
accepted: expected to have difficulty in completing
completedSentences: I expected to have difficulty completing the residency application.
I expected to have difficulty in completing the residency application.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: expected to have difficulty to completing
questionAudits.rationale: expect to have difficulty doing或in doing保留对申请难填的过去预期，并不声称后来实际失败；to completing不能替代这一动名词结构。
